title: Business Development & Product Manager (EdTech SaaS)
description:
**About the Role**

We are hiring a Business Development & Product Manager who can win institutional customers and shape the product they buy. You will own the school and college sales pipeline from first conversation to onboarding, run pre-sales and product demos, and carry what you hear from institutions back into the product roadmap.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Development**

* Identify, pitch and close deals with schools, colleges, universities and education groups.
* Build and manage a pipeline of leads through outreach, referrals, education events and partnerships.
* Handle the full sales cycle: discovery, proposal, pricing, negotiation, contract and handover.
* Work with decision-makers such as principals, directors, trustees, deans, HODs, IT heads and admin teams.
* Meet quarterly and annual revenue targets and report pipeline health to leadership.

**Pre-Sales & Demos**

* Run discovery calls to understand each institution's workflows, pain points and budget.
* Deliver tailored product demos, onsite and online, that map features to the institution's needs.
* Lead pilots and proofs of concept, and respond to RFPs and tenders.
* Prepare proposals, ROI cases, comparison decks and demo environments.

**Product Management**

* Convert customer feedback and market insights into product requirements, user stories and roadmap priorities.
* Work with engineering, design and customer success on feature releases.
* Track competitors and education trends such as NEP, accreditation requirements and digital learning.
* Define product positioning, packaging and pricing with leadership.
* Write product collateral, user guides and sales enablement material.

**Customer Success & Growth**

* Support smooth onboarding and adoption after the sale.
* Drive renewals, upsells and referrals from existing institutions.
* Gather case studies and testimonials from successful implementations.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline. MBA or a technology/business postgraduate degree is preferred.
* 4-8 years in business development, pre-sales, product management or a mix of these.
* Proven experience selling to **schools and colleges**, with a track record of closing institutional deals.
* Hands-on experience in **pre-sales and product demos** for **education and SaaS products**.
* Strong understanding of the SaaS model: subscriptions, onboarding, churn, renewals and ARR.
* Familiarity with education products such as LMS, ERP, admissions, assessment or learning platforms.
* Strong skills in presentation, negotiation and stakeholder management.
* Ability to write PRDs, user stories and prioritised roadmaps.
* Comfort with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce) and product tools (Jira, Figma, Notion).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* An existing network among school chains, colleges or education groups.
* Experience with government or institutional procurement, RFPs and tenders.
* Knowledge of regional education boards (CBSE, ICSE, state boards) and higher-education norms (UGC, AICTE, NAAC/NBA).
* Experience with data and analytics for sales and product decisions.
* Willingness to travel for institution visits and education events.

Key Skills

Institutional sales, pre-sales, demo delivery, product management, roadmap planning, SaaS metrics, solution selling, negotiation, communication, CRM, analytical thinking.

What We Offer

* Competitive fixed salary plus performance-based incentives
* Ownership across sales and product, with a direct line to leadership
* Growth path toward Head of Growth or Head of Product

Pay: ₹1,400,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have hands-on experience selling SaaS/technology products to schools, colleges, universities, or other educational institutions?
* Have you independently handled the complete B2B/institutional sales cycle—from lead generation and discovery through proposal, negotiation, closure, and onboarding/handover?
* Do you have hands-on experience conducting product demos or pre-sales presentations for SaaS/EdTech/technology products?

Work Location: In person

title: Product Owner
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

##### **Responsibilities**

We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Frontline team. You'll be at the forefront of product development, helping shape a platform trusted by operational teams in various industries all across the world. As Product Owner in our agile scrum team, you'll:

* Own and execute one or more features and modules within TeamViewer Frontline (https://www.teamviewer.com/en/products/frontline), from ideation and discovery through delivery and iteration.

* Foster agile practices and methodologies in the development teams and govern the development processes

* Collaborate across teams within Product, Engineering, UX, Marketing, Sales, and Support to build a compelling roadmap with global impact.

* Champion the customer, translating feedback into clear requirements and KPIs, and ensuring the team delivers the most valuable outcomes.

* Drive insight-led decisions, using qualitative and quantitative data such as telemetry and surveys, market trends, and competitive analysis to validate product ideas.

* Enable seamless delivery, ensuring your teams understand the purpose, deliverables, and impact while removing blockers.

* Balance feasibility and innovation, partnering with engineers to deliver intuitive, technically sound solutions that delight users and scale efficiently.

##### **Requirements**

* Experience: Min. of 2 years as a Product Owner in software environments, or equivalent experience. Background in SaaS, AI, B2B, logistics, field service management, communications or authoring software is a plus.

* Technical fluency: Comfortable working with engineering teams and participating in technical conversations. Have a basic understanding of SaaS technologies and concepts, previous coding experience is a plus. Familiarity with tools like Jira and Confluence.

* Agile Development: Ability to act as a value maximizer. PSPO certification or equivalent is a plus.

* Customer-centric mindset: Strong empathy, ability to synthesize feedback, and translate it into actionable insights and clear priorities.

* Analytical skills: Familiar with data-driven decision-making and confident defining and tracking product KPIs.

* Adaptability: Comfortable working in agile environments where priorities can shift and evolve.

* Communication: Excellent written and verbal English, with experience working in international teams.

* Educational background: Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

* Proven ability to manage roadmaps for data Ingestion platforms , Data management feature/functions (Data Quality, Data Governance, Information delivery etc.) including execution, implementation, and influencing skills within the asset management space.
* 8+ years of experience of as a Product Manager (Ideal but not vital) that owns all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle in a B2B enterprise SaaS environment.

title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
**Paid Media Specialist / Performance Marketing Specialist** **About the Role**
We are looking for a Paid Media / Performance Marketing Specialist who can independently plan, execute, optimize, and report on multi\-channel paid media campaigns for domestic and international clients.  

The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, DV360, and preferably Teads Ad Manager, with a strong understanding of campaign strategy, audience targeting, tracking, analytics, optimization, and client communication. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Paid Media Strategy \& Planning*** Develop comprehensive paid media strategies based on client objectives, target audiences, budgets, and KPIs.
* Create and present media plans covering budget allocation, channel mix, audience targeting, campaign objectives, bidding strategies, and creative requirements.
* Recommend the right combination of Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, DV360, Teads, and other relevant paid media channels.
* Identify opportunities to integrate paid media with SEO, content, email, social media, and other digital/ATL channels.
Conduct competitor, audience, keyword, and market research to identify growth opportunities.  
* 

  

**2\. Paid Media Campaign Execution \& Management*** Set up, manage, monitor, and optimize campaigns


**o Google Ads – Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, Demand Gen, Shopping****o Meta Ads – Facebook \& Instagram****o LinkedIn Ads****o TikTok Ads****o DV360****o Teads Ad Manager**

* Manage campaign budgets, bids, pacing, frequency, reach, and performance against KPIs.
* Implement A/B and multivariate testing across creatives, audiences, landing pages, bidding strategies, ad copies, and campaign structures.
* Continuously optimize campaigns to improve ROAS, CPA, CPL, CTR, CPC, CPM, conversions, and overall campaign efficiency.
* Ensure campaigns follow appropriate taxonomy, naming conventions, tracking, brand safety, and platform best practices.

 **3\. Tracking, Analytics \& Measurement*** Work with relevant teams to ensure accurate implementation of Google Tag Manager, GA4, conversion tracking, pixels, UTMs, Floodlight, and other tracking solutions.

* Analyze campaign performance using Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, DV360, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and other reporting platforms.
* Identify gaps in tracking and recommend corrective actions.
Ensure campaign data is reliable and aligned with client reporting requirements.  
* 

  

**4\. Reporting \& Insights*** Prepare weekly, monthly, and ad\-hoc performance reports for clients and internal stakeholders.
* Analyze campaign data and translate it into clear, actionable insights.
* Highlight key performance trends, challenges, opportunities, and recommendations.

Maintain accurate campaign trackers, budgets, pacing reports, and performance dashboards.

**5\. Campaign Optimization \& Growth*** Proactively identify opportunities to improve campaign performance, scalability, and efficiency.
* Develop and implement new testing methodologies across audiences, creatives, bidding, placements, keywords, and campaign structures.
* Identify opportunities for budget reallocation based on channel and campaign performance.
* Stay updated with changes in Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, DV360, Teads, GA4, and the broader paid media ecosystem.

 **6\. Client Management \& Communication*** Act as a secondary point of contact for assigned clients and maintain strong professional relationships.
* Participate in regular client calls to discuss campaign performance, upcoming campaigns, strategy, and optimization opportunities.
* Understand client briefs and translate business objectives into effective paid media strategies.
* Communicate campaign results, insights, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
Coordinate with internal teams including SEO, Content, Creative, Development, Analytics, and Business Development to deliver integrated digital marketing solutions.  
* 

  

**7\. Media Partner Management*** Build and maintain effective relationships with media and technology partners.
* Coordinate with platform representatives and partners for campaign support, troubleshooting, optimization opportunities, and industry updates.
* Explore relevant alpha/beta programs, new platform features, and testing opportunities.
Share campaign briefs with partners and incorporate relevant recommendations into media strategies.  
* 

  

**Required Skills \& Experience*** 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in Paid Media / Performance Marketing.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads
* Experience with one or more of DV360, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, and Teads Ad Manager.
* Strong understanding of:


 o Google Search Ads
 o Performance Max
 o YouTube Ads
 o Display Advertising
 o Remarketing/Retargeting
 o Audience Targeting
 o Lead Generation
 o Conversion Campaigns
 o Shopping Ads
* Good understanding of GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and attribution.
* Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.
* Experience with campaign reporting and performance dashboards.
* Good understanding of KPIs such as ROAS, CPA, CPL, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR, Reach, Frequency and Conversion Rate.

Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Google Ads certification.

* Experience working in a digital marketing agency environment.
